newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH PM SAYS AGROBANKA MOVE CAUSES NO PANIC - CTK.
newsitem.headline: CZECH PM SAYS AGROBANKA MOVE CAUSES NO PANIC - CTK.

text.p: Czech Prime Minister Vaclav Klaus said on Tuesday there should be no reason for a banking panic following the central bank's move to put the largest private bank Agrobanka a.s. under temporary forced administration due to liquidity problems, the CTK agency said.
"There isn't even the slightest reason for any sort of banking panic," it quoted Klaus as saying.

Klaus said the move by the central bank after an overnight meeting of the Czech government earlier on Tuesday, is a way to stop any kind of dangerous avalanche in the banking sector, the local news agency CTK said.

The CNB said it had placed the bank under temporary forced administration after it experienced liquidity problems arising from the failure of Kreditni Banka Plzen a.s. and the investigation of people in the Kreditni case who are also connected to Agrobanka.
In placing Agrobanka under forced administration, the CNB added: "The business of Agrobanka, in all trading outlets, continues as normal. Agrobanka has sufficient capital and reserves."
The central bank said on Tuesday that it would guarantee all creditors of Agrobanka.
